title: Learning to cook at 30
text:
Hello, readers! I'm Anna, and until this year I couldn't cook. Really – I only made toast and instant noodles. I always ate in cafés or ordered food online. It was expensive and not very healthy.

In January I decided to change that. I bought a simple cookbook for beginners and I promised myself one new recipe every week. My first dish was tomato soup. It was too salty, but my boyfriend ate it all and said, "Not bad!"

Now I can make pancakes, pasta with vegetables, chicken curry and a chocolate cake. My favourite is the curry – it's quick, cheap and delicious. I still make mistakes. Last week I burned the rice and the kitchen smelled terrible for two days!

Here are my tips for new cooks: start with easy recipes, buy fresh vegetables at the market and don't be afraid of mistakes. Cooking is like any skill – you get better with practice.

Next month I want to try baking bread. Wish me luck!
